data.cached_sql:
SELECT
  CATEGORY_NAME AS 카테고리,
  SUM(SALES_AMT) AS 매출액,
  ROUND(SUM(SALES_AMT) * 100.0 / SUM(SUM(SALES_AMT)) OVER (), 2) AS 매출비중
FROM (
  SELECT
    STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.ORDER_DATE) AS YM,
    p.CATEGORY_CD,
    c.CATEGORY_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_CNT,
    SUM(i.QTY) AS QTY,
    SUM(i.AMOUNT) AS SALES_AMT
  FROM TB_ORDER AS o
  JOIN TB_ORDER_ITEM AS i
    ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
  JOIN TB_PRODUCT AS p
    ON i.PROD_ID = p.PROD_ID
  JOIN TB_CATEGORY AS c
    ON p.CATEGORY_CD = c.CATEGORY_CD
  WHERE
    NOT o.STATUS IN ('04', '05')
  GROUP BY
    STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.ORDER_DATE),
    p.CATEGORY_CD,
    c.CATEGORY_NAME
) AS VV_SALES_MONTHLY
WHERE
  YM >= STRFTIME('%Y-%m', DATE('now', '-3 months'))
GROUP BY
  CATEGORY_NAME
ORDER BY
  매출액 DESC
